summary: Two label collisions found by the market-intelligence stand-in screen. A direct label longer than the 96px lane (a domain such as muller-brockmann.example) painted past the chart's frame onto the card beside it; now, when any series name measures wider than the lane's 80px, the chart drops every direct label and end marker and the plot takes the lane back — the legend (two or more series) or the title (one) already names every line. And a Rule's label, always above the rule's end, was crossed by a line ending a little over its own target; it now sits under the rule (data-placement="below") when a shown line runs through its place above and the place below is clear and inside the plot, decided from the data so the server draws the same side.
